name: Leafbound View
notes: The world fills the game window at every supported resolution, with Health and Energy anchored to the bottom corners. A square minimap and Character share a restrained gold leaf frame inside the playfield. Minimap and the entire Character card minimize independently and remember their state on this computer. Several bags can stay open in a scrollable stack that stops above the Energy ornament. Checked the installed Windows client at 720p, 1080p, 1440p, ultrawide and 85–125% UI scale. Existing item ownership, combat, maps and saves are unchanged.
